title: 763. Special Binary String

examples.explanation: Neighboring balanced blocks are swapped recursively to maximize the order.
Identical primitives keep the string unchanged.

hints: Split s into primitives: scan with a balance counter and cut whenever it returns to zero.
A primitive has the form 1 + inner + 0; recurse on the inner part, rewrap it, and collect all primitives.
Sort the rewrapped primitives in descending order and concatenate them.
